title: S’gor to settle debt to federal govt | The Star
text:
S’gor to settle debt to federal govt | The Star
SHAH ALAM: Selangor is on track to pay off its RM19mil debt to the Federal Government next year.
In tabling the state budget for 2024 here yesterday, Mentri Besar Amirudin Shari said it is possible to repay RM19,207,475.78 to the Federal Government in 2024 as the state is on sound financial footing.
